scripts.pretest: npm run build:rust && npm run build
scripts.demo: npm run build:rust && npm run build && tsx tests/e2e-poc/demo.ts
scripts.demo:critical: npm run build:rust && npm run build && tsx tests/e2e-poc/critical-demo.ts
scripts.benchmark: node scripts/cargo.mjs build --release --locked -p zkvm-bridge && tsx tests/benchmarks/run.ts
scripts.build:guest: node scripts/cargo.mjs build --release --locked -p policy-guest-riscv --features bare-metal --target riscv32im-unknown-none-elf && node scripts/check-guest.mjs
